name: od-higgsfield-media
title: Higgsfield media
description: Prefer the Higgsfield MCP OAuth connection for image/video generation, then wrap the result as a live artifact. Falls back to media-* atoms when MCP is unavailable.

description_i18n.en: Prefer the Higgsfield MCP OAuth connection for image/video generation, then wrap the result as a live artifact. Falls back to media-* atoms when MCP is unavailable.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 优先用已 OAuth 连接的 Higgsfield MCP 生成图像/视频，再包成 live artifact；MCP 不可用时回退到 media-* atom。

query.en: Generate media for: {{prompt}}. Prefer the connected Higgsfield MCP tools; if they are unavailable, use the project media atoms. Save the file and wrap it with a live artifact.
query.zh-CN: 为以下需求生成媒体：{{prompt}}。优先用已连接的 Higgsfield MCP；不可用则用项目 media atom。保存文件并用 live artifact 包起来。
